title.value: Human attachments shape interbrain synchrony toward efficient performance of social goals
title.justification: The title captures the essence of the study, which explores how human attachments influence interbrain synchrony to achieve efficient social goal performance.
title.quote: Human attachments shape interbrain synchrony toward efficient performance of social goals

analysis.description: This paper investigates how human attachments influence interbrain synchrony and behavioral synchronization during social interactions using hyperscanning EEG in male-female pairs. It explores motor coordination and empathy as two ecologically valid tasks, identifying patterns of brain rhythms and behavioral synchrony among couples, friends, and strangers to achieve efficient performance in social goals based on attachment strength.
